# Manyang Disability Foundation

> Non-profit providing mobility aids, healthcare access, inclusive education, and sustainable livelihoods for persons with disabilities.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Foundation overview and impact highlights.
- [About](/about): Mission, governance, and team.
- [Programs](/programs): Wheelchair, healthcare, education, and livelihood programs.
- [Gallery](/gallery): Field photos from our programs.
- [News](/news): Field dispatches and announcements.
- [Get Involved](/get-involved): Volunteer, partner, and support opportunities.
- [Donate](/donate): Fund wheelchairs, surgeries, and inclusive classroom tools.
- [Donate Used Medical Supplies](/guides/donate-supplies): How to donate used wheelchairs, crutches, and medical equipment.
